stage: C source retirement and compiled package; production cutover incomplete

package.name: research-loop
package.deploymentArchive: application-root archive; extract then npm ci --omit=dev

sourceRetirement.oldLaunchers: Python package/console script, launcher and examples removed from source
sourceRetirement.retained: independent Cactus scripts and historical ProTok assets/readme
sourceRetirement.spikes: historical only; excluded from production archive

loc.convention: Nonblank token-bearing source lines, comments/docstrings excluded; prompts, schemas and platform glue included. Generated lockfiles/prose excluded. Task adapter and synthetic provider/tests separate.

authority.research: immutable accepted Plan, backend receipt and Review records
authority.knowledge: published Markdown file; framework stores the prepared draft for recovery, not a separate queryable knowledge authority
authority.submission: original authorization ID + slot intent, native local job identity and immutable result

modules: engine: native Task and role orchestration
experiments: bounded source freeze and original submission reconciliation
cpu-job: detached local prediction and trusted scoring
files: research records and atomic knowledge publication
exceptionalPaths: STOP or original deadline: no new admission, existing effects may be reconciled
unknown submit acknowledgement: query/bind/collect original identity, never resend
invalid/final-only/identity mismatch: reject as research evidence
failed role or incomplete tool: explicit failure or authorized resume; no blind external replay
failed Manager: old notes plus pending reviewed input retained
unsupported/writable/incomplete legacy snapshot: refuse or report unknown; no migration
frameworkConcepts: owned conversation and tool replay semantics

limitations: No actual deployment target or active legacy Study inspected or migrated
Installed wheels, services, launchers, supervisors and remote original jobs remain unverified
Only local macOS arm64 CPU verified; no Linux/Windows, GPU or remote execution
Compiled package CPU smoke uses synthetic fixed inputs and no model; it does not establish research benefit
Stage B DeepSeek Flash evidence is historical and is not rerun by the packaging smoke
History cannot prove snapshot consistency or current job/deployment liveness; original operator/platform reconciliation remains necessary
